mint_authority.mechanism: FiatTokenV2_2 mint() is onlyMinters and requires minterAllowance[msg.sender] >= amount; minters are configured by the MasterMinter contract; the MasterMinter is a Circle-controlled contract

attacker_eth_call_probes.mint(dead,1): revert: FiatToken: caller is not a minter
attacker_eth_call_probes.configureMinter(dead,1e18): revert: FiatToken: caller is not the masterMinter
attacker_eth_call_probes.updateMasterMinter(dead): revert: Ownable: caller is not the owner
attacker_eth_call_probes.pause(): revert: Pausable: caller is not the pauser
attacker_eth_call_probes.blacklist(dead): revert: Blacklistable: caller is not the blacklister

backing.model: custodial: cirBTC is 1:1 backed by native BTC held in custody by Circle International Bermuda Limited (CIBL); mint/redeem via Circle Mint for KYC'd institutions
backing.reserve_verification: Chainlink Proof of Reserve integration planned (not live at snapshot)
backing.cross_chain: issued natively on Ethereum and Arc; CCTP support planned, not live

defillama.note: DefiLlama's figure corresponds to ~467 BTC; the on-chain totalSupply at the snapshot block is 848.70 cirBTC (~$68.3M at $80,446/BTC). The discrepancy is a DefiLlama-side accounting/price lag and does not affect the verdict.

verdict: E-U $0 — custodial, permissioned mint; no unprivileged release path
